method: Visual inspection of both final Cycles PNGs and saved-scene assertion checks

checks.assembled: One pump bottle and one tube, readable original script logos and product names, no clipping; contact shadows and soft cast shadows visible; copper highlight retains detail.
checks.expanded: Complete pump with hollow transparent long dip tube; body, tube cap, decorative sleeves and white printing layers separated; all parts remain in frame; seamless backdrop after correction.
checks.reference: Retains copper/ivory bottle and rose/ivory tube proportions and approved lettering; no formula included.
checks.source: Reopened actual blend; six groups, three camera poses, packed textures, floor/backdrop synchronization and reset checked.

corrections: Reduced flat ambient lighting and tightened key reflection.
Fixed the dark backdrop gap during expansion by animating backdrop with the receiving floor.
limits: Appearance inferred from reference artwork, not measured physical material or color calibration.
Floating white print has lower contrast against the warm studio background than on the closed copper surfaces.
Cycles offline output does not establish equivalent browser real-time quality; web v1 assets and production unchanged.
